title: AI Actors for UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Choose a named AI actor for a UGC-style product ad. Browse selfie-style presenters by scene, age range and product category, then start with a spoken prompt.
h1: Choose an AI Actor for UGC Ads
lead: Browse on-camera actors by setting and style. Each presenter holds a sample product and delivers a short line straight to camera.
intro: These generated adult presenters are designed for product ads. Choose a setting and a delivery format, then replace the sample product and line with details you can support.
Every card opens the spokesperson workspace with a Seedance-style prompt. The people shown are AI-generated actors, not customers or independent reviewers.

how_to.d: Start with a clear view of the product and keep its real details intact.
Pick a scene and delivery style that fits the product and audience.
Use a specific, supportable detail, then review the generated result before publishing.

items.d: Do not present a generated person as someone who bought or used the product.
A testimonial must reflect a real, authorized customer statement; do not invent personal experience.
Do not portray an actor as a doctor or make unsupported health or performance claims.

faq.q: Can AI actors speak in UGC ads?
faq.a: Yes. The spokesperson workspace can generate an actor delivering a short spoken line that you provide.
No. They are generated presenters and should never be described as actual customers.

faq.q: Can an AI actor give a testimonial?
faq.a: Do not invent a customer testimonial. Use real, authorized customer words or frame the line as a brand-written product explanation.

faq.q: How do I create an AI actor product ad?
faq.a: Add your product, choose an actor and delivery style, write a supportable line, then review the result.
